runs.text: Israel as a cat. Nine <<ˈ|l|aɪ|v|z>>. Cats are independent. Israel declared independence on May fourteen, one thousand nine hundred and forty eight. The next day, five armies invaded. Life one, used. Landed on its feet. Life two: one thousand nine hundred and sixty seven. Life three: one thousand nine hundred and seventy three, a surprise attack on Yom Kippur. Feet first, again. Life four: two thousand and twenty four. Iran's regime fired over three hundred drones and missiles in one night. ninety nine percent were stopped. Cats are curious. Israel has fourteen Nobel laureates, for about ten million people. Cats get ignored, until you need one. Waze? Israeli. The chip that helps your car brake? Mobileye, from Jerusalem. And after all that, it still lands on its feet: the eighth happiest country on Earth. No cat is perfect. Same rules for every cat. Dog or cat: which one is Israel? Lives left? Count them:
